premises.text: Critical metals for electronics and energy storage have concentrated country supply that creates price and access risk for manufacturers
premises.evidence_span: while there's a globally distributed need for these materials, the supply of them is focused in a small number of countries

premises.text: Unlike bulk metals, low-abundance rare earth metals lack a competitive electrochemical purification process
premises.evidence_span: for low abundance metals like the rare earth ones that are used in all of the electronics sitting in your pockets or perhaps on your wrists, there is no such competitive process

premises.text: Charged carbon-nanotube mesh filters electrochemically precipitate and separately recover metals from liquid solutions at high purity
premises.evidence_span: delivering a charge across the mesh of carbon nanotube filters to try and precipitate metals contained in a liquid solution as solid materials

premises.text: Near-term value is reclaiming metals from manufacturing effluent; longer-term value is digesting disassembled device components
premises.evidence_span: our short-term goal is to try to improve fabrication efficiencies in manufacture

value.text: Manufacturers regain control of metal supply by reclaiming metals from waste and end-of-life products
value.evidence_span: returns control of the metal supply chain to the manufacturer

causal_links.evidence_span: China reduced the supply of rare earth elements to the global markets
put new life into new process from reclaimed metals

notes: v1.5.1 process+performance package: purity, recovery rates, cobalt/nickel demos, and coffee-cup form factor folded into P3.
